textbook_summary: Adjacent QRS dominant direction alternates during bidirectional VT.

authored_choices.vector_pair: Original authored ventricular electrode QRS/T vector on even ordinals, exact opposite on odd ordinals

invariants: Two-beat selector retains original ventricular ordinals across recovery
All ventricular electrodes transformed together to retain limb identities
Electrical sign does not change event timing, per-beat filling policy, CVP or respiration
Both demos share source and reject capture/fusion combinations or orphan flags
limitations: One authored opposite vector pair, not an anatomical activation or digitalis/CPVT mechanism model
Secondary T reversal is an authored choice; other vector pairs and clinical variants remain open
No hemodynamic calibration, onset/termination, accelerated idioventricular rhythm or TdP
